title: Visualizing and annotating phylogenetic trees
summary: A complete browser-compatible BioLang companion to BDSR chapter 13: Newick and BEAST/Nexus import, phylograms and cladograms, rectangular, slanted, and circular layouts, all three exercises, ggtree-compatible node numbering, MRCA, clade labels and highlights, taxon links, an influenza H3 alignment, and the source chapter's seeded multi-tree facets.

source.title: Stephen D. Turner, Ph.D. — Biological Data Science with R: Visualizing and Annotating Phylogenetic Trees
source.note: Independent OriClabs BioLang companion under MIT. It follows the public section and exercise order but does not copy or relicense upstream prose, R code, tables, or figures. The teaching-tree file retains its separate terms and attribution. This is not an official BDSR publication or endorsement.
